steps.measured: no symmetry of the box pairs it one to one with T-174's packing by nearest centres; the optimal assignment, under the best of the box's eight symmetries, moves 47 squares beyond 0.1 and 60 beyond 1e-2 (largest 0.885496) and turns 58 squares by more than 1e-6 radians, by up to 44.36 degrees; 36 squares tilted beyond a degree, 27.3 to 41.4 degrees from upright and all turned the same way, against T-174's 35, 41.2 to 44.4 degrees, near the diagonal, where no split by sign is given; a new arrangement relative to T-174's packing, not a further arrangement of it, as the source's band built from the registry's 70 says
